# MarketCentaur

> MarketCentaur delivers AI-led transformation for every business, serving small and mid-sized businesses worldwide. It pairs human strategy with machine speed, combining AI-speed research with human review to fix common growth problems (websites that don't convert, B2B sales teams targeting the wrong accounts, repetitive work that should be automated) and runs done-for-you AI services: AI search visibility (GEO), AI front desks, AI content and video production, localization and AI training.

## Core packages
- [Website Conversion Sprint](https://marketcentaur.com/services.html#conversion-sprint): Five-pillar conversion audit, top-10 fix list, rewritten headline and CTA copy, and an AI search visibility check (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity). First findings in 48 hours; full report in 3–5 business days.
- [B2B Account Intelligence Sprint](https://marketcentaur.com/services.html#account-sprint): ICP definition, ranked target-account list with sources, buying-role map, buying signals, competitor snapshot and outreach angles. Delivered in 5 business days.
- [AI Workflow Automation Sprint](https://marketcentaur.com/services.html#automation-sprint): Workflow mapping, ranked automation shortlist, pilot design with human approval steps, SOPs and an AI-use register. Delivered in 5–7 business days.
- [Growth Intelligence Retainer](https://marketcentaur.com/services.html#retainer): Ongoing signal watch, competitor tracking, performance briefs and fractional AI advice, billed monthly.

## Done-for-you AI services
- [AI Search Visibility (GEO)](https://marketcentaur.com/services/ai-search-visibility.html): Audits and ongoing optimization of how ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot and Google AI Overviews describe and recommend a business. Up to 25 buyer questions, competitor share-of-voice, gap analysis and a prioritized fix list; monthly re-testing for managed GEO.
- [AI Front Desk](https://marketcentaur.com/services/ai-front-desk.html): AI receptionist for phone calls plus WhatsApp and website chat assistants that answer FAQs, book appointments, capture leads and hand off to staff. Set up, tested and managed monthly.
- [AI Content & Video Studio](https://marketcentaur.com/services/ai-content-studio.html): Monthly AI-assisted production of short-form and explainer videos, social posts, blogs, newsletters and sales collateral, human-reviewed; white-label option for agencies.
- [AI Localization & Translation](https://marketcentaur.com/services/ai-localization.html): Websites, sales collateral, courses, product documents, subtitles and AI voiceover in new languages, with glossaries and human review.
- [AI Training & Workshops](https://marketcentaur.com/services/ai-training.html): Practical generative AI workshops for leaders, marketing, sales, operations and support teams, with prompt libraries and AI-use policies.

## Contact
- Email: hello@marketcentaur.com

## How we work
Scope, deliverables, timeline and price are agreed in writing before work starts. A person reviews all AI-assisted work, and every important finding links to its source. Pricing is a fixed quote after a free 20-minute scoping call. Outcomes such as leads or rankings are not guaranteed; deliverables and timelines are.

## Practices
MarketCentaur offers 108 services across 17 practices. Every engagement is scoped and quoted on request; prices are not published.
- [All practices and bundles](https://marketcentaur.com/practices/)
- [AI Strategy & Readiness](https://marketcentaur.com/practices/ai-strategy.html): Find where AI can strengthen your work and turn the best opportunities into a practical plan. Services: AI Readiness Scan; AI Opportunity Workshop; AI Transformation Roadmap; AI Business Case & ROI Model; Fractional AI Officer.
- [Automation & AI Agents](https://marketcentaur.com/practices/automation-ai-agents.html): Reduce repetitive work with dependable automations and carefully governed AI agents. Services: Automation Opportunity Audit; Workflow Automation Sprint; AI Agent Prototype; Custom AI Agent Build; Multi-agent Workflows; Automation Care; Agent Hosting & Tuning.
- [Customer Experience & Conversational AI](https://marketcentaur.com/practices/conversational-ai.html): Make customer conversations more helpful across calls, chat, WhatsApp and service journeys. Services: Customer Experience Review; Website Chat Assistant; AI Voice Front Desk (calls, booking, WhatsApp); Customer Support Automation; Review & Reputation Monitoring; Managed Assistant.
- [Marketing, Content & Video](https://marketcentaur.com/practices/marketing-content-video.html): Build a consistent content programme that gives your expertise a clear, useful voice. Services: Content Strategy & 30-day Calendar; Brand Video Pack; Explainer & Ad Set; Podcast & Webinar Repurposing; Content Engine; Video Studio; Email & Newsletter Programs.
- [Search, Web & Ecommerce Growth](https://marketcentaur.com/practices/search-web-ecommerce.html): Improve discoverability, conversion and retention across search, AI answers, your website and online stores. Services: AI Search Visibility Audit (SEO + GEO); Paid Media Plan; Website Conversion Sprint; Analytics & Tracking Setup; Growth Engine Launch; Ecommerce Growth Sprint; Marketplace Listings Setup (Amazon, Etsy and others); AI Search Starter; Conversion Optimisation; Email & Retention Flows; Paid Media Management.
- [Sales, Lead Generation & RevOps](https://marketcentaur.com/practices/sales-revops.html): Build a dependable sales operation with clean CRM data, stronger outreach and useful enablement. Services: CRM Health Check; CRM Setup or Migration (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, Dynamics 365); Outbound Engine Setup; LinkedIn Profile & Page Makeover; Sales Enablement Kit (decks, battlecards, proposals); Outbound Engine; Lead Intelligence; LinkedIn Content & Outreach Management; Fractional Marketing Ops & CRM Admin.
- [Events & Field Marketing](https://marketcentaur.com/practices/events-field-marketing.html): Turn events, webinars and trade shows into coordinated experiences with fast, useful follow-up. Services: Event Strategy & Calendar; Webinar & Virtual Event Production; Trade Show & Field Event Kit; Event Lead Follow-up Automation; Partner & Channel Program Management.
- [Strategy & Growth Advisory](https://marketcentaur.com/practices/strategy-growth-advisory.html): Make clearer growth decisions with evidence, focus and an actionable plan. Services: Sales & Go-to-Market Audit; Pricing & Packaging Review; Market Entry Brief; Business Plan & Pitch Deck; Fractional Growth Advisor.
- [Market, Competitive & Deal Intelligence](https://marketcentaur.com/practices/market-intelligence.html): Turn changing market, competitor and deal signals into timely, useful decisions. Services: Competitor Snapshot; Account & Persona Map; Supplier & Partner Scan; Industry Landscape Report; M&A and Partner Target Screening; Signal Watch; Competitor Offer Monitor; Deal-flow Watch; Sector Tracker.
- [Data, Analytics & BI](https://marketcentaur.com/practices/data-analytics.html): Build trustworthy data foundations, dashboards and forecasts people can use. Services: Data Readiness Check; Data Cleanup & Migration; KPI Dashboard Build; Forecasting Models; Analytics as a Service.
- [Knowledge, Document AI & Localization](https://marketcentaur.com/practices/knowledge-document-ai.html): Make organisational knowledge, document-heavy work and multilingual content easier to manage. Services: Document Workflow Review; Company Knowledge Assistant; Document Processing Pipeline (invoices, contracts, forms); Process & SOP Sprint; Localization (documents, websites, courses); Knowledge Upkeep.
- [Web, Apps & No-code Products](https://marketcentaur.com/practices/web-apps-no-code.html): Design and launch websites, portals, internal tools and MVPs without unnecessary complexity. Services: Website Teardown; AI-built Website; Landing Page Sprint; Internal Tool or MVP; Customer Portal; Site Care.
- [Cloud, Workplace & IT Modernization](https://marketcentaur.com/practices/cloud-workplace-it.html): Make everyday tools, cloud services and IT support work together reliably. Services: Workplace Tools Review; Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace Setup; Copilot & Gemini Rollout; Cloud Migration Planning; IT Care.
- [Cybersecurity & Data Privacy Readiness](https://marketcentaur.com/practices/cyber-privacy.html): Improve security and privacy practices with clear, actionable readiness work. Services: Security Basics Check; Data Privacy Readiness (GDPR, India DPDP); AI Security Review; Policy & Training Pack; Quarterly Security Review.
- [People, HR & Change](https://marketcentaur.com/practices/ai-training-change.html): Help people build confidence, capability and good habits around AI and change. Services: Team AI Bootcamp; Leadership AI Workshop; Competitive Intelligence Workshop; HR Workflow Automation (recruiting, onboarding); Change Management Support; AI Academy (self-paced); Monthly AI Clinic.
- [Governance, Risk, ESG & Compliance](https://marketcentaur.com/practices/ai-governance.html): Create practical oversight for AI, continuity and responsible business commitments. Services: AI Policy & Use Register; ESG & Continuity Readiness Check; AI Governance & EU AI Act Readiness; ESG Narrative Reporting; Quarterly Governance Review.
- [Operations, Finance & Supply Chain](https://marketcentaur.com/practices/operations-finance.html): Make back-office, finance and supply-chain workflows clearer, connected and easier to manage. Services: Back-office Automation Audit; Finance Ops Automation (invoices, payables, reporting); Procurement & Supplier Automation; Inventory & Logistics Dashboards; Ops Care.
- [AI Readiness Score](https://marketcentaur.com/ai-readiness-score.html): free 10-question self-assessment across strategy, data, processes, people and governance.
